assumptions: The populations given are the units of interest; the estimator chosen (Weir and Cockerham, Hudson or Patterson) suits the sample sizes.
limits: Estimators differ systematically, especially at small sample sizes, so the estimator is named with the number.
A block jackknife standard error assumes the blocks are independent.
bio.jane/contract.question: How differentiated are these populations, per site and averaged, with a jackknife standard error?

description: Differentiation between populations of a call set: Weir and Cockerham's θ over two or more populations, or Hudson's or Patterson's Fst between pairs, per site and averaged with a block-jackknife standard error (scikit-allel). Every pair when more than two populations are compared. Validated on every site of 1000 Genomes phase 3 APOL1 for the 5 super-populations and 26 populations.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

blockLength.description: sites per jackknife block for the average's standard error; a trailing partial block is dropped, as scikit-allel does.

compare.description: the populations to compare, comma-separated; empty is every group of the column.

estimator.description: weirCockerham: θ from the variance components over every compared population at once. hudson: 1 − within / between pairwise differences (Bhatia 2013). patterson: F2-based, biallelic sites only. Values: weirCockerham (Weir–Cockerham θ), hudson (Hudson Fst), patterson (Patterson Fst).

groupBy.description: which column of the sample table groups the samples; empty is its first grouping column.

populations.description: a sample table: a header row with a `sample` column and one or more grouping columns (tab-separated, as 1000 Genomes' .panel). Samples it does not list belong to no group.

vcf.description: the call set as VCF text (a .vcf, or a .vcf.gz already decompressed); every record's GT is read, ploidy 2.

name: population_fst

average.description: per comparison: the populations, Fst over all sites, its jackknife standard error, blocks

matrix.description: pairwise average Fst between every compared population (Hudson and Patterson)

sites.description: per site: pos, and per comparison the site's Fst (numerator / denominator), null where undefined
